description: Scientific split of the 20-dive pilot into DEVELOPMENT_DESIGN (14) and INTERNAL_EVAL (6). Frozen before human annotation. Sessions kept whole. Split uses metadata/session grouping only — no annotation information used.
split_rationale: INTERNAL_EVAL uses session 26 (2025-02-23, 4 dives: 160/191/192/169) plus session 51 (2025-05-27, 1 dive: 848) plus session 138 (2026-06-30, 1 dive: 2281). All three sessions are kept whole (no session split across sets). Selection used only session metadata and temporal ordering — not annotation correctness or landmark values. Canary dives 2661/2169/311/2555/2387 kept in DEVELOPMENT_DESIGN; canary dive 192 is in INTERNAL_EVAL.
leakage_controls: Split determined before any human annotation was performed
INTERNAL_EVAL human labels must not be inspected for Baseline B parameter selection
Session grouping ensures dives from the same session cannot appear in both sets
No annotation errors or landmark ordering used as split criteria

INTERNAL_EVAL.note: Contains 1 of 6 proxy canary dives (192). Session 26 block (4 dives) is a contiguous natural grouping from 2025-02-23.

limitations: INTERNAL_EVAL is NOT a general holdout set — it is a small internal check for this pilot only
6 dives is insufficient for broad generalization claims
Group 4 (401 dives) appears only in DEVELOPMENT_DESIGN (only 1 such dive: 311)
Group 0 (010 dives: 2661, 2680) appears only in DEVELOPMENT_DESIGN
No claim of broad generalization allowed from either subset
